issues.sprint: Sprint 1: IoT Gateway Hardening & Cryptographic Pipeline
issues.summary: Implement HMAC-SHA256 Telemetry Signature Ingestion Pipeline
issues.description: As a Security Operations Center Analyst, I want all incoming smart bin telemetry to be verified with HMAC-SHA256 using edge hardware device keys so that adversaries cannot spoof false fill levels.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a telemetry packet with valid HMAC signature
When it hits POST /api/iot/telemetry
Then the gateway responds with HTTP 201 Created and saves reading.

Given a packet with tampered payload or forged signature
When it hits POST /api/iot/telemetry
Then the gateway responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request, marks node as COMPROMISED, and logs a CRITICAL audit event.

issues.sprint: Sprint 1: IoT Gateway Hardening & Cryptographic Pipeline
issues.summary: GIS Geofence Anomaly Detection Tripwire (50m Boundary)
issues.description: As an Operations Dispatcher, I want reported bin coordinates to be verified against registered GPS anchors using geodesic calculation so that physically relocated or GPS-spoofed nodes are instantly detected.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given reported coordinates deviating > 50 meters from registered anchor
When telemetry is ingested
Then the gateway rejects the packet with HTTP 400 and logs LOCATION_ANOMALY with HIGH severity.

issues.sprint: Sprint 2: Autonomous TSP Route Engine & Driver Manifest
issues.summary: Greedy Nearest-Neighbor TSP Route Optimization Engine
issues.description: As a Municipal Fleet Dispatcher, I want an autonomous optimization algorithm to calculate the shortest round-trip path from Chennai Central Depot visiting all high-fill bins so that fuel and drive time are minimized.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a set of bins with fill >= threshold
When route optimizer is triggered
Then it starts at Depot [13.0827, 80.2707], greedily visits the nearest unvisited node, returns to Depot, and outputs cumulative distance, duration, and carbon savings.

issues.sprint: Sprint 2: Autonomous TSP Route Engine & Driver Manifest
issues.summary: Interactive Field Driver Waypoint Manifest & Collection Checklist
issues.description: As a Field Truck Driver (Rajesh Kumar), I want a turn-by-turn waypoint manifest where I can click [Mark Collected] at each bin so that progress is tracked and bin telemetry resets in real time.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an active dispatched route
When the driver clicks [Mark Collected] on a stop
Then bin fill resets to 0%, stop is marked with a checkmark badge, and the route progress bar increments towards 100%.

issues.sprint: Sprint 3: Enterprise RBAC Isolation & Security Gateway Lab
issues.summary: Strict Profile RBAC Isolation: Driver vs Security Analyst Partitioning
issues.description: As a Chief Information Security Officer, I want field drivers to be strictly partitioned to their route manifest without access to intrusion logs, while security analysts have access to threat logs and gateway testing.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given active profile is 'Rajesh Kumar (Field Driver)'
When navigating the sidebar
Then Intrusion Logs and Security Gateway Lab are hidden, and unauthorized access attempts trigger the Access Control Barrier.

Given active profile is 'SOC Security Analyst'
When inspecting the sidebar
Then Intrusion Logs and Security Gateway Lab are visible, and Route Dispatching is hidden.

issues.sprint: Sprint 3: Enterprise RBAC Isolation & Security Gateway Lab
issues.summary: Dedicated Left Sidebar Tab: Security Gateway & Attack Lab
issues.description: As a Security Analyst, I want a dedicated left sidebar lab below Intrusion Logs to simulate valid HMAC packets, inject spoofed hashes, and test geofence violations with a live monospace terminal.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the user navigates to the 'Security Gateway Lab' tab
When clicking 'Inject Spoofed Hash'
Then the terminal displays payload and HMAC mismatch in red, and a critical incident is added to Intrusion Logs.

issues.sprint: Sprint 1: IoT Gateway Hardening & Cryptographic Pipeline
issues.summary: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline with Automated SAST & Container Scanning
issues.description: As a Release Manager, I want every git push to run automated unit tests, Bandit SAST security scans, and Trivy container vulnerability audits before merge.
issues.acceptanceCriteria:
Given code pushed to main
When GitHub Actions runs
Then test-and-scan and build-container jobs must pass 100% green without critical vulnerabilities.
